title: Apply average speed formula

hook.scenario: Aapko ek city dusre city tak jana hai, total rasta 120 km hai. Agar aap chahte hain ki 2 ghante mein pahunchein, toh aapko lagataar kitni speed maintain karni padegi?
hook.question: Hum average speed ke formula ko palat (rearrange) kar ke unknown chizein kaise nikalte hain?

mental_model.intuition: v = s/t ek triangle ki tarah hai. Agar 2 values pata hon, to 3rd value asani se nikal jati hai.
mental_model.description: Formula v = s/t (Speed = Distance / Time) mein agar aapko Speed (v) aur Time (t) diya ho, toh aap inko multiply kar ke Distance (s) nikal sakte ho (s = v * t). Agar Time nikalna ho, toh t = s/v kar sakte ho. Ye ek universal key hai.

explanation:
Pichle topics mein humne padha ki average speed, total distance aur total time ko divide karke aati hai. Equation form mein isko likhte hain: v = s / t. Yahan 'v' (velocity ya speed) ke liye hai, 's' (space ya displacement/distance) ke liye, aur 't' time ke liye hai. (Dhyan rakhna, variables mein 's' distance ke liye use hota hai, speed ke liye nahi).

CBSE exams mein hamesha simple total distance / total time nikalne ko nahi aata. Kai baar woh aapko average speed pehle hi de dete hain aur kisi ek hisse ka distance ya time puchte hain. Aise numericals mein hum formula ko rearrange karte hain. Agar aapko distance nikalna hai, toh aap time ko udhar bhej kar multiply kar denge: s = v × t. Agar aapko time pata lagana hai, toh formula banega t = s / v.

Kuch numericals multi-step hote hain. Jaise journey ko do (2) parts mein divide kar dete hain (t1 aur t2). Aise case mein pehle har part ka time alag se nikalna padta hai (t1 = s1/v1, aur t2 = s2/v2). Phir total time (t1 + t2) aur total distance (s1 + s2) ko main formula mein daalna padta hai.

Ek aur zaroori baat: calculation shuru karne se pehle ensure karo ki saari units ek hi system mein hon. Agar distance kilometer mein hai, toh speed km/h mein honi chahiye, ya time ghanto (hours) mein hona chahiye. Varna conversion zaroori ho jata hai (jaise 5/18 factor use karna).

key_points.title: The formula triangle
key_points.detail: v = s / t. Can be rearranged to s = v * t (for distance) or t = s / v (for time).

key_points.title: Use correct variables
key_points.detail: In physics, 's' usually stands for displacement/distance, not speed. 'v' is used for speed/velocity.

key_points.title: Multi-part journeys
key_points.detail: Always find total distance separately and total time separately, then divide them. Do not average the speeds directly.

worked_example.problem: A car travels at an average speed of 60 km/h for 2.5 hours. How much distance did it cover?

steps.narration: Distance nikalne ke liye speed aur time ko multiply karte hain (s = v * t).

worked_example.problem: A bus covers a distance of 180 km at an average speed of 45 km/h. How long did the journey take?

steps.narration: Time nikalne ke liye distance ko speed se divide karte hain (t = s / v).

common_mistakes.title: Using 's' for speed
common_mistakes.explanation: Kai students formula mein speed ki jagah 's' likhte hain. Physics mein s = distance/displacement. Speed ko 'v' likhna chahiye taaki aage ke equations of motion me confusion na ho.

common_mistakes.title: Mismatched Units
common_mistakes.explanation: Distance km mein hai aur time seconds mein diya hai. Usme units ko bina match kiye (bina hours me badle) direct divide kar dena result ko completely wrong kar deta hai.

recall_questions.q: What formula relates distance (s), speed (v), and time (t)?
How do you rearrange v = s / t to solve for t?
What does the symbol 's' represent in kinematics equations?

oa_questions.question: A car travels 30 km at a uniform speed of 40 km/h and the next 30 km at a uniform speed of 20 km/h. Find its average speed.
oa_questions.approach: Find t1 = 30/40 = 0.75h. Find t2 = 30/20 = 1.5h. Total time = 2.25h. Total distance = 60 km. Average speed = 60 / 2.25 = 26.67 km/h.

oa_questions.question: An artificial satellite is moving in a circular orbit of radius 42250 km. Calculate its speed if it takes 24 hours to revolve around the earth.
oa_questions.approach: Distance = Circumference = 2 * pi * r = 2 * 3.14 * 42250 = 265460 km. Speed = Distance / Time = 265460 / 24 = 11060.8 km/h.
